atlases.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production raster sprite atlas for a top-down science-fiction aircraft game. One atlas exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 equally sized square cells, landscape 4:3. Each cell contains one richly painted 3D game skill icon, large readable central silhouette, metallic material and glowing energy; consistent dark navy square backgrounds, edge-to-edge cells, no drawn frames, no text, no letters, no numbers, no gutters. Keep each subject inside its own cell with 10% safe margin; distinct readable skill mechanics at 48 pixels. Not SVG, not flat primitive symbols. Follow exact row-major order. Row 1 Viper emerald fighter: (1) a fighter deploying a bright decoy flare away from itself, (2) fighter engines blasting long cyan afterburner flames, (3) a red targeting reticle locking onto an enemy fighter with tracking rays, (4) a dense fan of homing missiles with green smoke trails. Row 2 Titan heavy gunmetal bomber: (1) massive blue energy armor dome encasing a heavy fighter, (2) one heavy metal bomb descending into an orange blast, (3) a purple gravitational anchor pulling small enemies inward, (4) twin heavy rotary cannon barrels unleashing golden bullet streams. Row 3 Phantom violet stealth aircraft: (1) fighter fading into a translucent cloaking silhouette, (2) a brilliant narrow violet continuous laser from a fighter, (3) an electronic jammer emitting concentric violet interference pulses, (4) one small companion drone with a bright gun muzzle beside its aircraft.
